name: Fortify Wine
body:
School transmutation; Level adept 1, bard 1, cleric 1, druid 1, ranger 1, sorcerer/ wizard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./ 2 levels)
Targets 1 gallon of alcoholic beverages/level
Duration permanent
Saving Throw Will negates (object); Spell Resistance yes (object)

DESCRIPTION

Fortify wine heightens the potency of alcoholic beverages without changing its taste or other characteristics. Affected beverages count as two drinks when determining how many can be imbibed without being sickened. Those drinking affected exotic drinks, such as dwarven fireale and elven absinthe, have a –2 penalty to Fortitude saves to avoid addiction and negative effects, and the duration of all effects (both positive and negative) is doubled.

Additional castings of fortify wine on the same drink have no effect.
